notes.title: [INTRODUCING] Memories of Zattera - A Multi-Perspective Visual Novel
notes.content:
[h2]The Story So Far:[/h2]
[h3]In a world torn between the mystic glow of the stars and the power of human innovation, two nations waged a decade-long war in the skies above the Celestial Archipelago. Ahlfar, a land blessed by ancestral magic, followed the guidance of the heavens. Kyrguios, a realm devoid of magic, rose through science and technology, defying nature with advanced machinery.

The last war changed everything. For the first time, Kyrguios' superior strategy and cutting-edge ships crushed Ahlfar's celestial forces. Facing devastation, Ahlfar's King made a historic choice: to abandon blind tradition and embrace Kyrguios' innovations.[/h3]

[h2]Our Protagonists:[/h2]

[h3]Baldwin: The tactical leader of the Royal Patrol, a survival specialist grappling with moral dilemmas.

Brunnya: A dwarven cleric who abandoned stagnant traditions for a war that will test her faith to its limits.

Leon: A former crime lord now hunting his old allies – but can he ever truly escape his past?

Will: A gifted bard seeking glory... even if it means rewriting the truth to achieve it.

Anturiel: An elven seer who knows too much, speaks too little – with an ego as vast as his visions.[/h3]
